@valodzka @AndrewBourgeois are you cancel the connect by any chance ?
If you mean calling io.netty.util.concurrent.Future#cancel - no, it's never called in my application.

@normanmaurer : No. I've only seen this error a few times while load testing a Java proxy application that uses Netty. The only app that closes a connection explicitly is the client simulator (which is also written using Netty) which only does that once it has received a reply for every message sent (500 per connection to be exact).
@valodzka @AndrewBourgeois would it be possible to have a producer for it ?
@normanmaurer I can try to reproduce bug with some custom (debug) netty build on our servers. I don't know way to reproduce it with artificial small example.
@AndrewBourgeois @valodzka could you check with 4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT? Should be fixed now.
Yep, I did a few runs with 4.0.15.Final-SNAPSHOT and haven't seen error. Look like it's fixed.
